notes: Two isnads after the same saying (the second ends «بهذا»): two groups, each with its own names, so no shared tail
The second group's «بهذا» is a back reference to the first isnad and is kept as the final link; no names are inherited
«سعيد» (occurrence 3) is the standalone name in «عن سعيد عن أبي هريرة», not the «سعيد بن أبي سعيد» of the first isnad
The Prophet is the end, not a link
